data.name: Request.InvalidBody
data.value: The request body is invalid. Check the JSON structure and the data types of the fields.

data.name: Logistics.DuplicateTicketCode
data.value: An ore dispatch ticket with the same ticket code already exists.

data.name: Logistics.TruckAlreadyAssignedToShift
data.value: The truck already has an ore dispatch ticket for the same dispatch date and shift.

data.name: Logistics.InvalidOreDispatchTicketData
data.value: The ore dispatch ticket data is invalid.

data.name: Validation.InvalidTicketCode
data.value: The ticket code must be a non-empty GUID.

data.name: Validation.InvalidHaulTruckCode
data.value: The truck code must follow the format CAT-797F-XXX or KOM-930E-XXX, where XXX is a number between 001 and 999.

data.name: Validation.InvalidShiftCode
data.value: The shift code must be DAY-A or NIGHT-B.

data.name: Validation.NonPositiveWeight
data.value: The cargo weight in tons must be greater than zero.

data.name: Validation.BlankWeightUnit
data.value: The unit of the cargo weight must not be null or blank.

data.name: Validation.NegativeHaulageRate
data.value: The rate per ton must be greater than or equal to zero.

data.name: Validation.OreCapacityExceeded
data.value: The cargo weight exceeds the maximum capacity allowed for the ore grade.

data.name: Validation.InvalidSupervisorUsername
data.value: The supervisor username is required and must have between 5 and 25 characters.

data.name: Validation.FieldObservationsTooLong
data.value: The field observations must not exceed 120 characters.

data.name: Validation.UndefinedEnumValue
data.value: The value received is not defined for the field.
